reading: Tommy Walsh, a building and DIY expert who starred on several television shows, has died at the age of 69.
His agent told BBC News that Walsh died peacefully after a long illness, with his family around him, and asked for privacy for the family.
Walsh worked as a professional builder before becoming known to television audiences.
He got his big break after restoring the home of a BBC producer who was developing ideas for a show that later became Ground Force.
Walsh said he turned down the offer to appear on the show three times.
He said he agreed after his eight-year-old daughter told him about a £10 bet she had made with a boy at school.
She had bet that her father would appear on television.
Walsh appeared on the BBC’s Ground Force with Alan Titchmarsh and Charlie Dimmock from 1997 to 2005.
On Ground Force, Walsh’s co-stars carried out makeovers on gardens that belonged to members of the public.
He went on to present Cowboys and Angels as well as Clean It, Fix It.
In 2021, Walsh joined the daytime programme Homes Under the Hammer.
Walsh also published several books about DIY projects that people can do themselves.

vocabulary.definition: Someone who represents another person in their working life and may speak to the media for them.
The freedom to deal with personal matters without public attention.
An important opportunity that helps someone become successful in their career.
Repairing a building to bring it back into good condition.
Said no to an offer or invitation.
An agreement in which someone can win or lose money depending on whether a prediction comes true.
Changes that give places a new look.
Did something else later, often as the next step in a career.

entries.ja: 仕事上の事柄でほかの人を代表し、その人に代わってメディアに話をすることもある人。
entries.ko: 다른 사람을 업무상 대표하고, 그 사람을 대신해 언론과 이야기하기도 하는 사람.
entries.zh-Hans: 在工作事务上代表他人，也可能代替对方与媒体沟通的人。
entries.es: Persona que representa a otra en asuntos profesionales y que puede hablar con los medios de comunicación en su nombre.
entries.pt-BR: Pessoa que representa outra em assuntos profissionais e pode falar com a mídia em nome dela.
entries.fr: Personne qui représente quelqu’un dans sa vie professionnelle et qui peut s’exprimer en son nom auprès des médias.
entries.de: Eine Person, die jemanden in beruflichen Angelegenheiten vertritt und in dessen Namen mit den Medien sprechen kann.

entries.ja: 世間の注目を浴びずに、個人的な事柄に対処できる自由。
entries.ko: 세간의 관심을 받지 않고 개인적인 일을 처리할 수 있는 자유.
entries.zh-Hans: 可以在不受公众关注的情况下处理个人事务的自由。
entries.es: La libertad de ocuparse de asuntos personales sin atraer la atención del público.
entries.pt-BR: A liberdade de cuidar de assuntos pessoais sem chamar a atenção do público.
entries.fr: La liberté de s’occuper de ses affaires personnelles à l’abri des regards du public.
entries.de: Die Freiheit, sich um persönliche Angelegenheiten zu kümmern, ohne dabei im Blick der Öffentlichkeit zu stehen.

entries.ja: 仕事で成功する助けとなる重要な機会。
entries.ko: 직업적으로 성공하는 데 도움이 되는 중요한 기회.
entries.zh-Hans: 能帮助人在职业生涯中取得成功的重要机会。
entries.es: Una oportunidad importante que ayuda a alguien a tener éxito en su carrera profesional.
entries.pt-BR: Uma oportunidade importante que ajuda alguém a ter sucesso na carreira.
entries.fr: Une occasion importante qui aide quelqu’un à réussir dans sa carrière.
entries.de: Eine wichtige Gelegenheit, die jemandem hilft, beruflich erfolgreich zu werden.

entries.ja: 建物を修理して、再び良い状態にすること。
entries.ko: 건물을 수리해 다시 좋은 상태로 되돌리는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 修缮建筑物，使其恢复到良好状态。
entries.es: Reparar un edificio para que vuelva a estar en buen estado.
entries.pt-BR: Reparar uma construção para deixá-la novamente em bom estado.
entries.fr: Réparer un bâtiment pour le remettre en bon état.
entries.de: Ein Gebäude reparieren, um es wieder in einen guten Zustand zu bringen.

entries.ja: 申し出や招待を断った。
entries.es: Rechazó una oferta o una invitación.
entries.pt-BR: Recusou uma oferta ou um convite.
entries.fr: A refusé une offre ou une invitation.
entries.de: Lehnte ein Angebot oder eine Einladung ab.

entries.ja: 予想が当たるかどうかで、お金を得たり失ったりする可能性がある取り決め。
entries.ko: 예상이 맞느냐에 따라 돈을 따거나 잃을 수 있는 약속.
entries.zh-Hans: 一种约定，参与者可能赢钱，也可能输钱，取决于预测是否成真。
entries.es: Un acuerdo por el que alguien puede ganar o perder dinero según se cumpla o no una predicción.
entries.pt-BR: Um acordo em que alguém pode ganhar ou perder dinheiro conforme uma previsão se confirme ou não.
entries.fr: Un accord dans lequel une personne peut gagner ou perdre de l’argent selon qu’une prédiction se réalise ou non.
entries.de: Eine Vereinbarung, bei der jemand Geld gewinnen oder verlieren kann, je nachdem, ob eine Vorhersage eintrifft.

entries.ja: 場所の見た目を一新する変更。
entries.zh-Hans: 让场所呈现出新面貌的改动。
entries.es: Cambios que dan un nuevo aspecto a los lugares.
entries.pt-BR: Mudanças que dão uma nova aparência a espaços.
entries.fr: Des changements qui donnent une nouvelle apparence à des lieux.
entries.de: Veränderungen, durch die Orte ein neues Aussehen bekommen.

entries.ja: その後、別のことをした。多くの場合、それは仕事での次の一歩だった。
entries.ko: 나중에 다른 일을 했다. 흔히 그 일은 경력의 다음 단계였다.
entries.zh-Hans: 后来做了别的事，这往往是职业生涯中的下一步。
entries.es: Más adelante hizo otra cosa, a menudo como siguiente paso en su carrera profesional.
entries.pt-BR: Fez outra coisa mais tarde, muitas vezes como o próximo passo na carreira.
entries.fr: A fait autre chose par la suite, souvent en passant ainsi à l’étape suivante de sa carrière.
entries.de: Tat später etwas anderes, oft als nächsten Schritt im Berufsleben.

review.method: separate ChatGPT plan translation and independent editing sessions
